name: Putrescent Glob
text:
Usage affixed to a weapon

Activation F envision

Trigger You damage a creature that is Sickened 1 with a Strike using the affixed weapon

Requirements You are an expert with the affixed weapon.

---

This repulsive, hairy glob dangles from the end of your weapon. When you activate the putrescent glob, the creature you damaged must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save save or its sickened condition increases to Sickened 2, and it can't reduce its sickened condition until the end of its next turn. On a critical failure, it's also Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.
